headlines.title: MSTR Purchases Bitcoin After 2-Week Pause, Keeps Buying Back STRC: BMNR, ASST Keep Adding To Their Crypto Treasuries
headlines.summary: Michael Saylor’s Strategy repurchased 1.77 million STRC shares for $174 million, taking its combined Bitcoin and STRC spend to nearly $250 million for the week.

headlines.title: MSTR Stock Climbs Overnight: This Analyst Sees Upside Of 16.5% From Current Levels
headlines.summary: B. Riley raised the price target on Strategy to $195 from $175 and maintained a ‘Buy’ rating on the shares, implying an upside of about 16.5% from current levels.

headlines.title: Strategy CEO Phong Le Reveals the One Mistake Behind STRC's 25% Collapse
headlines.summary: Strategy CEO Phong Le says unexpected leverage sank STRC to $75 and explains why buybacks beat a dividend hike.

headlines.title: Analyst predicts 35% upside for Saylor's Strategy
headlines.summary: Michael Saylor’s Strategy is now sitting on an unrealized profit of around $9 billion on its Bitcoin holdings.

headlines.title: MicroStrategy CEO Says JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon Is a Bitcoiner Behind the Scenes
headlines.summary: Strategy CEO Phong Le says JPMorgan's Jamie Dimon privately backs Bitcoin, despite calling it a pet rock in public.

description: Strategy Inc, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a bitcoin treasury company in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. It offers investors varying degrees of economic exposure to Bitcoin by offering a range of securities, including equity and fixed income instruments. The company also provides AI-powered enterprise analytics software, including Strategy One, which provides non-technical users with the ability to directly access novel and actionable insights for decision-making. In addition, the company provides Strategy Mosaic, a universal intelligence layer that offers enterprises with consistent definitions and governance across data sources, regardless of where that data resides or which tools access it. The company was formerly known as MicroStrategy Incorporated and changed its name to Strategy Inc in August 2025. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia.
